name: Drag lift
where: Board cards (phone long-press 300ms; desktop mouse-down + 4px)
steps: t0: long-press recognised → haptic LONG_PRESS
0–180ms: scale 1 → 1.04, rotate 0 → −2°, shadow card → lift (lift)
while dragging: card follows pointer 1:1; rotation = clamp(velocityX × 0.02, −3°, 3°), eased 120ms
origin slot: dashed outline (2.5px, line-strong 25%) at card height
neighbours: when card centre crosses a neighbour midpoint, neighbour springs to new slot (settle 320ms, +6px overshoot); haptic SEGMENT_TICK
drop: card springs into slot (settle 260ms), scale → 1, rotate → 0, shadow → card
reduced: No scale/tilt; card gets 2px ink outline + shadow; neighbours jump.

name: Drop target (tab / lane)
where: Phone: Column tabs while card above list area; desktop: lanes
steps: phone: card above y < tabs+60px → card scales to 0.5 over 280ms so tabs stay visible

enter target: target grows 1.16 (phone tab) / 1.012 (lane), fills with its accent, glow ring 7px accent 35%; others dim to 45% / 60%; background tints 22% toward target · pop 240ms; haptic GESTURE_THRESHOLD_ACTIVATE
hover: wiggle ±3° (tab) / ±0.3° (lane) 600ms, repeats every 1.2s
leave: reverse in 200ms
drop on tab: card scales to 0.05 + rotate −40° into tab 420ms (swoosh); tab squash 1.32/.84 → .9/1.1 → 1; count rolls; 5-pebble burst; slot collapses 400ms, list closes up · haptic CONFIRM
drop on current Column tab: card moves to top of list
drop on lane (desktop): coloured slot opens at insert index (dashed accent, 128px), card settles into it
reduced: Target: accent fill + ring only, no scale/wiggle. Drop: card fades; count swaps.

name: Gekocht celebration + toast
where: Gekocht button on card / detail
steps: 0ms: press scale .94 (tap); haptic CONFIRM on release
0–480ms: button springs 1.12 → 1, fills sage, check draws (stroke-dashoffset 20 → 0, 260ms from +120ms)
0–620ms: veggie confetti (native Vue/SVG particles, 14 pieces, gravity arc; not video)
+300ms: card leaves Column (slides +440px, rotate 8°, 360ms swoosh), list closes up (settle)
+320ms: Gekocht tab bumps 1.22 + count rolls up
+500ms: toast springs in (380ms settle); Topfbert clip pops up behind toast (+100ms) and plays "Mmh!"
toast: "Gekocht · Notiz hinzufügen · Rückgängig"; undo window 5s (progress bar); FAB moves up 76px
5s: toast out 300ms; Rückgängig reverses all (card flies back 480ms)
10th cooking: after toast in, 10× milestone plays (420ms delay)
reduced: Button colour + check, card fades out, toast fades in. No confetti, Topfbert still frame.

name: Swipe between Columns
where: Phone Board
steps: horizontal pan > 8px and |dx| > 1.2|dy| → capture; list follows finger 1:1
edges: rubber-band 0.3×
progress p = idx − dx/width drives: headline translateX(offset × 70px) + opacity 1 − |offset| × 1.6; active tab pill position; background colour mix
release: |dx| > 18% width or velocity > 0.5px/ms → next Column; spring settle 480ms; haptic SEGMENT_TICK
background colour cross-fades 600ms to new Column tint
reduced: Swipe still pages; release snaps in 150ms fade; no parallax.

name: Card → detail morph
where: Tap card (phone full-screen, desktop side panel)
steps: shared element: card thumbnail → header image; interpolate left/top/width/height/border-radius (20px → 0) over 600ms swoosh
phone: Board behind scales to 0.94, detail background fades in (0–30%); content panel rises from +90px (from 30%, 420ms settle)
desktop: 480px panel slides from +100% x (480ms sheet); Board dims (scrim)
buttons (back, …) pop in at 80% (pop)
placeholder illustrations start their loop once morph ends
close / back gesture: exact reverse; image lands in card
Nuxt: use View Transitions API (view-transition-name per card image) with a fallback FLIP implementation
reduced: Detail cross-fades in 200ms; no scale of Board.

name: Sheet open / close
where: All bottom sheets
steps: open: scrim fades 0 → 1 (260ms); sheet translateY(100%) → 0 (440ms sheet, ~10px overshoot)
contents: first section rises 14px from +150ms (fade)
drag handle: follows finger, resistance 0.5 upwards; release > 25% height or velocity > 0.8 → close
close: translateY(100%) 320ms ease-in, scrim out 240ms
keyboard: sheet sits on top of keyboard; keyboard rises 360ms
stacked sheet: parent scales 0.96 and dims 20%
desktop ≥768px: sheet renders as Dialog (scale .92 → 1, 360ms)
reduced: Fade 200ms, no slide.

name: Reorder a Recipe line
where: RecipeEditor, Zutaten and Schritte (each list on its own; no dragging between lists)
steps: t0: long-press grip 300ms (touch) or mouse-down on grip + 4px (pointer: fine) → haptic LONG_PRESS
0–180ms: line scale 1 → 1.03, rotate 0 → −1.5°, shadow → shadow.lift, surface fill (lift), same as Columns in Board Settings
origin: dashed slot 2px line-strong, radius.field, height = line height

while dragging: line follows the pointer on y only; neighbours spring to their new slot when the line centre crosses their midpoint (settle 320ms, +4px overshoot) · haptic SEGMENT_TICK; Step numbers update with each swap (number rolls 12px, 200ms)
near sheet edge (48px): autoscroll up to 12px/frame
drop: line settles into the slot (settle 260), scale 1, rotate 0, shadow none

keyboard / screen reader: grip button opens menu "Nach oben" / "Nach unten" (pop 460); Alt+↑/↓ on desktop; line moves to its slot (settle 480), focus stays on its grip; live region: "{line}, jetzt an Stelle {n} von {total}."
reduced: No scale or tilt: 2px text outline + shadow.lift. Neighbours and keyboard moves jump to their slot. Numbers swap.

name: Paste lines
where: Any RecipeLine textarea in the editor
steps: paste event with \n in the text → preventDefault
split on line breaks; trim; drop empty lines; strip a leading "•", "-", "*", "–", "1.", "1)"
first piece replaces the selection in the current line (text before the caret stays), the rest become new lines below it; the text after the caret goes to the end of the last new line
cap at 60 Zutaten / 40 Schritte and 200 / 1000 characters per line (longer pieces are cut at the limit)
0ms: new lines insert at full height; each fades 0 → 1 with 30ms stagger (max 8, rest together)
0–1600ms: new lines tinted color.paste-tint, ease-out to transparent
+120ms: Toast "{n} Zutaten eingefügt" / "{n} Schritte eingefügt" + Rückgängig (5s); over the limit: "{k} Zeilen haben nicht mehr reingepasst."
caret to the end of the last new line; scroll it 24px above the keyboard
reduced: Lines appear at once; tint holds 1.6s then switches off; toast fades in.

name: A found Recipe arrives
where: Dish detail, RecipeSection slot, for every Member watching the Dish (realtime)
steps: result arrives (realtime) while "Rezept wird gesucht" is shown
0–300ms: Topfbert search hops (y −7) and shrinks to .7 + fades; the card scales .97 + fades (ease-in)
300ms: card removed; RecipeSection mounts. Content above is unchanged, so scroll position never moves
300–540ms: "Rezept" header fades in (fade 240)
380–860ms: Zutaten card rises 14px + fades (settle 480)
460ms+: Zutaten lines rise 10px + fade (420 settle), stagger 60ms, max 8, the rest with the 8th
Zutaten start + 8×60 + 120ms: Schritte card rises, its lines stagger the same way
if the slot is not in the viewport: no animation is seen; Toast "Rezept gefunden" + "Zeigen" (scrolls to the Recipe, swoosh 600)
haptic: none (it is not the user's own action)
reduced: Search card crossfades to the finished lists in 200ms. No hop, no rise, no stagger.

name: Recipe switch (long Recipes)
where: Dish detail, when RecipeSection is taller than 2 viewports and both lists exist
steps: show when the Zutaten card top passes under the top bar; hide when the source line / end of Schritte passes
show: fade 240 + y −8 → 0; hide: reverse
active = Schritte once the Schritte card top is within 60px under the switch
tap: smooth scroll (swoosh 600) to the list heading, 12px under the switch; active swaps on arrival
reduced: Switch fades only; scroll jumps.

name: Switch views
where: ViewSwitch on every Board (Spalten ↔ Woche)
steps: t0: tap a segment; haptic SEGMENT_TICK; write localStorage "malkochen:view"
0–480ms: thumb slides (settle 480); labels swap colour (200)
to Woche: Columns fade 240 + x 0 → −28 (settle 480); phone background Column tint → bg (600 ease); FAB fades (200)
to Woche: WeekView x +28 → 0 (settle 480); WeekDays opacity 0 → 1, y 14 → 0, stagger 40ms from +140ms; phone list is already scrolled to today before it appears
to Spalten: WeekDays fade together (160), WeekView x → +28; Columns come back from −28 (settle 480); background bg → Column tint (600)
Column swipe position and week position are kept per Board while the app is open
reduced: Thumb jumps, views crossfade 200ms, no shift, no stagger.

name: Browse weeks
where: WeekHeader ‹ ›, phone horizontal swipe on the list, "Heute"
steps: phone swipe: horizontal pan > 8px and |dx| > 1.2|dy| → capture; the list follows 1:1 with rubber-band 0.3 beyond 25% width; release > 18% width or velocity > 0.5px/ms → next / previous week; haptic SEGMENT_TICK
out: days x ∓40 + fade 160
in: days from x ±40 → 0 (settle 480), stagger 30ms; title crossfades (fade 240)
phone: after a browse the list starts at Monday (current week: at today)
"Heute" appears when the shown week is not the current one (pop 460) and leaves when it is (fade 150); tap = browse back in one step (the same slide, from the side of the current week)
desktop: ← / → (with the WeekView focused) browse, T jumps to Heute
reduced: Week swaps with a 200ms crossfade; no slide, no stagger.

name: Drag a Planned Dish within a day
where: WeekDay list (phone + desktop)
steps: t0: long-press 300ms (touch) or mouse-down + 4px (pointer: fine) → haptic LONG_PRESS
0–180ms: scale 1 → 1.04, rotate 0 → −2°, shadow.small → shadow.lift (lift), as Interaction "Drag lift"
origin: dashed slot 2px line-strong, radius.planned, Planned Dish height
while dragging: follows the pointer; a neighbour springs to its new slot when the centre crosses its midpoint (settle 320, +4px overshoot) · haptic SEGMENT_TICK
drop: settles into the slot (settle 260), scale 1, rotate 0, shadow.small
tap without movement after the long-press: nothing (no detail)
reduced: No scale or tilt: 2px text outline + shadow.lift; neighbours jump.

name: Drag a Planned Dish to another day
where: Phone: DayStrip + list autoscroll. Desktop: WeekDay columns as targets.
steps: lift as "within a day"; phone: DayStrip drops in under the title (y −10 → 0 + fade, settle 300)
phone, list: within 64px of the top or bottom edge the list autoscrolls up to 12px/frame; entering a day block highlights it (fill butter 12%) and opens a slot at the index

phone, strip: pointer above strip bottom + 40px → card scales to .56 (280) so the strip stays visible; the day under it: scale 1.16, butter fill, ring 6px butter 35%, others dim to .6 · pop 240 · haptic GESTURE_THRESHOLD_ACTIVATE; wiggle ±3° every 1.2 s

phone, drop on a pebble: card scales to .05 and rotates −40° into it (420 swoosh); pebble squash 1.32/.84 → .9/1.1 → 1; strip fades (200); the Planned Dish is added at the end of that day; origin slot collapses (settle 420) · haptic CONFIRM
past days: dimmed to .3 in the strip, never targets; dropping there snaps back
desktop: entering a column → fill butter 16%, ring 3px butter 55%, butter dashed slot (Planned Dish height) at the insert index (pop 240); drop settles into it (settle 260)
live region after the drop: "{Titel}, jetzt am {Wochentag} an Stelle {n} von {total}."
reduced: Strip appears without slide; target fill + ring only, no scale or wiggle; drop fades the card into place.

name: Plan from +
where: WeekDay "+" → DishPicker
steps: tap "+": press scale .9 (tap); DishPicker opens (Sheet open / desktop pop 360)
type: filters per keystroke (no debounce up to 500 Dishes)
tap a row: press scale .98; haptic CONFIRM
0–320ms: picker closes (sheet translateY 100% ease-in / popover fade + scale .97 200)
+0ms: the day opens a slot at its end, height 0 → Planned Dish height (settle 380)
+120ms: the Planned Dish drops in from y −14, scale .96 (settle 520)
phone: if the day's end is off screen, the list scrolls it into view first (swoosh 600)
no toast
reduced: Picker fades out (200), the Planned Dish appears in place.

name: Plan from Einplanen
where: Dish detail share row "Einplanen" → DayPicker
steps: tap "Einplanen": press tap; DayPicker opens on this week (from today)
› / ‹: week change as in DayPicker motion; ‹ disabled on this week
tap a day: haptic CONFIRM; picker closes (320)
+120ms: Toast "Für {Wochentag} eingeplant." (heute / morgen / "{Wochentag}, {d}. {Monat}" after this week) + "Rückgängig" (settle 400, 5 s bar)
the detail itself does not change
Rückgängig: removes that Planned Dish again
reduced: Picker fades out, toast fades in.

name: Move or reorder without dragging
where: PlannedDish "⋯" → PlannedDishMenu; accessibility actions; desktop keys
steps: "⋯" opens PlannedDishMenu (phone sheet / desktop pop 360, origin top right)
"Nach oben" / "Nach unten": menu closes, the Planned Dish travels to its new slot (settle 480), focus returns to its "⋯"

"Auf anderen Tag legen": DayPicker (this week, "Liegt hier"); pick → the Planned Dish leaves (x +44, fade 260) and settles in at the end of the new day (settle 480); Toast "Auf {Wochentag} gelegt." + Rückgängig
desktop: Alt+↑/↓, Alt+←/→ do the same without a menu
live region (polite): "{Titel}, jetzt am {Wochentag} an Stelle {n} von {total}."
reduced: Menu fades in; moves jump into place.

name: Take off the plan
where: PlannedDishMenu "Aus dem Plan nehmen"
steps: tap: menu closes; no Dialog (the Dish stays on the Board)
0–260ms: Planned Dish x +44 + fade (ease-in)
260–680ms: slot collapses (settle 420), the day closes up
+200ms: Toast "Aus dem Plan genommen." + Rückgängig (5 s)
Rückgängig: slot reopens and the Planned Dish drops back at its old index (settle 480)
reduced: Fades out 200ms, gap closes at once; toast fades in.

name: Set the cook
where: CookPicker
steps: tap a Member: haptic SELECTION; picker closes (320)
the avatar pops onto the Planned Dish (scale 0 → 1.12 → 1, pop 460), replacing a previous one (old fades 150)
"Offen lassen": avatar fades out (150); nothing replaces it
no toast; live region "{Name} kocht jetzt." / "Niemand kocht mehr fest."
reduced: Avatar swaps without pop.

name: Tick after Gekocht ✓
where: Today's PlannedDish "Gekocht ✓"
steps: 0ms: press scale .94 (tap); haptic CONFIRM on release; records a Cooking (same API as the card)
0–480ms: button springs .9 → 1.12 → 1 and fills sage, check draws (stroke-dashoffset 20 → 0, 260 from +120)
20–660ms: veggie confetti from the button (Vue/SVG particles, 6 phone / 5 desktop, not video)
the Dish moves into the Gekocht Column (not visible in Woche); the Planned Dish stays on its day
+380ms: tick pops onto the image: scale 0 → 1.25 → 1, rotate −30° → 8° → 0 (pop 460)
+520ms: Toast "Gekocht" + "Notiz hinzufügen" + "Rückgängig" (settle 400); +640ms Topfbert pops up behind it (pop 460) as on the card
once the toast is in (+2.2 s): button fades (240) and the Planned Dish shortens 100 → 64 (settle 480)
any Cooking of this Dish dated today (card, detail) ticks the Planned Dish the same way, without the confetti if it happened elsewhere
Rückgängig: removes the Cooking; tick fades (150), button and height come back (settle 480)
reduced: Button colour + check, tick appears, toast fades in; no confetti, Topfbert as the still; row shortens without motion.

name: Tick
where: ShoppingItem (whole row)
steps: 0ms: press scale .98 (tap); haptic SELECTION on release
0–380ms: pebble .82 → 1.18 → 1 (pop) and fills sage (180)
60–280ms: check stroke-dashoffset 20 → 0 (220 ease-out)
80–340ms: strike background-size 0 → 100% (260 ease-out); text colour → text-muted (200)
340–940ms: hold (motion.sink-hold 600); a second tap in this window unticks in place
940–1420ms: the line travels to the end of its group, lines below close up (settle 480)
live region: "{Text} erledigt."
syncs to every Member; offline: unsent mark (fade 240)
reduced: Fill, check and strike appear at once; after 600ms the line jumps to its place.

name: Untick and rise
where: A ticked ShoppingItem
steps: 0ms: press .98 (tap); haptic SELECTION
0–160ms: check retracts, fill → surface; strike 100 → 0% (200); colour → text (200)
760–1240ms: the line travels back to its Recipe place (Sonstiges: typing order), others make room (settle 480)
live region: "{Text} wieder offen."
reduced: Everything changes at once; the line jumps back after 600ms.

name: Delete with undo
where: ShoppingItem: swipe left (phone), trash on hover/focus or Delete key (desktop), delete button in the edit field, accessibility action
steps: phone: the row follows the finger, swipe-danger + trash + "Entfernen" behind it; at 96px haptic GESTURE_THRESHOLD_ACTIVATE
release past 50% width or flick > 600px/s: x → −105% (240 ease-in); shorter: springs back (settle 300)
desktop: x −24 + fade (200 ease-in)
+220ms (desktop +180): slot collapses (settle 380); last line of a group takes the group with it
+260ms: Toast "Eintrag entfernt." + Rückgängig (5 s), FAB up 76
Rückgängig: slot reopens and the line drops back at its old index (as arrive)
reduced: Fades out 200ms, gap closes at once; toast fades in.

name: Clear ticked with undo
where: "Erledigte entfernen" in the ShoppingList header (only while something is ticked)
steps: 0ms: press .94 (tap); no dialog
+0ms each, 30ms apart top to bottom: ticked lines fade (160)
+140ms each: their slots collapse (settle 380); groups left empty collapse with them
+120ms: the button fades out (200)
+200ms: Toast "{n} Einträge entfernt." / "1 Eintrag entfernt." + Rückgängig (5 s)
Rückgängig: lines grow back in place (settle 380), the button fades in (240)
reduced: Lines and button disappear at once; the toast fades in.

name: Type items in a row
where: Phone: FAB "Eintrag hinzufügen" or "Etwas aufschreiben" (empty list) → add bar on the keyboard. Desktop: the Sonstiges field ("n")
steps: open: FAB hides, bar rises with the keyboard, focus in the field; list scrolls to the top so Sonstiges is visible
typing: plain text, no parsing
Enter ("Weiter"): a slot opens at the end of Sonstiges' open lines (0 → 56, settle 380), the line drops in (y −10, .97 → 1, settle 460, +80); field clears, focus and keyboard stay
live region: "{Text} hinzugefügt."
Enter on empty / tap outside / keyboard down: bar closes, FAB returns (pop 460)
reduced: The line appears in place; the FAB appears without pop.

name: Change a line
where: ShoppingItem: long-press 450ms (phone, haptic LONG_PRESS), pencil / Enter / double click (desktop), accessibility action "Ändern"
steps: row → ShoppingItemInput (edit) crossfade 150, text selected, keyboard up (phone, return "Fertig")
Fertig / blur: save, crossfade back 150; the line keeps its place and its tick
Escape: cancel
empty text saved: Delete with undo
reduced: Row and field swap without motion.

name: Put a Dish on
where: Dish detail → "Auf die Einkaufsliste" (end of the Zutaten card, only with Ingredients) → IngredientPicker
steps: tap: press .94; phone Sheet open (440), desktop pop 360 from the button (origin bottom)
rows rise 14px, 40ms stagger, max 8; all ticked
toggle a row: fill 180 + check 200; button count updates; at 0 disabled "Keine Zutat ausgewählt"
confirm: press .97, haptic CONFIRM; sheet close 320 ease-in / popout 200
+200ms: Toast "{n} Zutaten auf der Einkaufsliste." + Rückgängig
lines go to this Dish's group (new at the end, or the existing one with "Zweimal auf der Liste")
reduced: Sheet / popover fade 200; toast fades in.

name: Put a week on
where: WeekHeader "Woche auf die Einkaufsliste" (current and later weeks)
steps: tap: press .94 (tap); haptic CONFIRM; no sheet

takes every Planned Dish from today (later weeks: Monday) to Sunday, in plan order; skips Dishes that already have a group and Dishes without Ingredients; a Dish planned twice in the range goes on twice
0–460ms: bag icon squash 1.3/.84 → .92/1.1 → 1 (pop)
+120ms, 40ms apart per day in range with Dishes: butter ring pulse 0 → 4px .6 → 0 (900 ease-out)
+120ms: Toast "{n} Gerichte auf der Einkaufsliste." + Rückgängig (removes exactly what was added)
nothing to add: squash only, Toast "Alles schon auf der Einkaufsliste." without action, 3 s
reduced: No squash, no pulse; the toast fades in.

name: Switch to the list
where: ViewSwitch "Einkauf"
steps: 0–480ms: thumb → third segment (settle 480), labels colour 200
0–240ms: current view fades, x 0 → −28 (settle 480); phone Column tint → bg (600) when coming from Spalten
+140ms: list x +28 → 0 (settle 480); groups y 14 → 0 + fade, 40ms apart
+200ms: FAB "Eintrag hinzufügen" pops in (scale 0 → 1, pop 460) when coming from Woche
opens scrolled to the top; stored in "malkochen:view"
leaving: groups drop out together (160), FAB shrinks (150) when going to Woche
reduced: Thumb jumps; views crossfade 200ms; FAB appears with them.
